WTXS21 PGTW 192000
MSGID/GENADMIN/JOINT TYPHOON WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI//
SUBJ/TROPICAL CYCLONE FORMATION ALERT (INVEST 93S)//
RMKS/
1. FORMATION OF A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE IS POSSIBLE WITHIN
055 NM EITHER SIDE OF A LINE FROM 3.9S 55.6E TO 5.2S 53.7E WITHIN
THE NEXT 12 TO 24 HOURS. AVAILABLE DATA DOES NOT JUSTIFY ISSUANCE
OF NUMBERED TROPICAL CYCLONE WARNINGS AT THIS TIME. WINDS IN THE
AREA ARE ESTIMATED TO BE 28 TO 33 KNOTS. METSAT IMAGERY AT
191800Z INDICATES THAT A CIRCULATION CENTER IS LOCATED NEAR 3.9S
55.5E. THE SYSTEM IS MOVING WESTWARD AT 05 KNOTS.
2. REMARKS: THE AREA OF CONVECTION (INVEST 93S) PREVIOUSLY LOCATED NEAR 
3.2S 57.1E IS NOW LOCATED NEAR 3.9S 55.5E, APPROXIMATELY 47 NM NORTH OF 
SEYCHELLES. ANIMATED ENHANCED INFRARED SATELLITE IMAGERY (EIR) DEPICTS 
AN AREA OF BROAD BUT CONSOLIDATING TURNING ON THE NORTHEASTERN SIDE OF 
FLARING CONVECTION. A 091530Z SSMIS 91GHZ PASS REVEALS INTENSE DEEP 
CONVECTION ON THE SOUTHWESTERN PERIPHERY OF 93S, WITH BROAD AND 
ASYMMETRIC, BUT DEFINED, FORMATIVE LOW-LEVEL CLOUD BANDS WRAPPING UNDER 
THE CONVECTION. A 191724Z METOP-C ASCAT PASS REVEALS ENHANCED WINDS 
ALONG THE SOUTHERN PERIPHERY OF THE ASYMMETRIC CIRCULATION CENTER. 
ENVIRONMENTAL ANALYSIS REVEALS LOW TO MODERATE VERTICAL WIND SHEAR (15-
20KTS), WARM SEA SURFACE TEMPERATURES (28-29C), AND MODERATE RADIAL 
OUTFLOW ALOFT. GLOBAL DETERMINISTIC AND ENSEMBLE MODELS ARE IN AGREEMENT 
IN THE GRADUAL DEVELOPMENT OF 93S, THOUGH DETERMINISTIC MODELS ARE MORE 
CONSERVATIVE THAN THE ENSEMBLES. 93S IS EXPECTED TO TRANSIT GENERALLY 
SOUTHWESTWARD AS IT CONSOLIDATES. MAXIMUM SUSTAINED SURFACE WINDS ARE 
ESTIMATED AT 28 TO 33 KNOTS. MINIMUM SEA LEVEL PRESSURE IS ESTIMATED TO 
BE NEAR 998 MB. THE POTENTIAL FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF A SIGNIFICANT 
TROPICAL CYCLONE WITHIN THE NEXT 24 HOURS IS HIGH.
3. THIS ALERT WILL BE REISSUED, UPGRADED TO WARNING OR CANCELLED BY 
202000Z.//
NNNN
